userStories.description: backend/src/lib/skill-matcher.ts: universal-scope skills are always selected within the token budget (filtered by appliesToStages); specialist skills stay LLM-reranked over the deterministic eligible set. acceptanceCriteria: Completed runs emit a findings record persisted with the run

Findings update workspace L2/L3 context and MEMORY.md through the existing memory synthesis path, and become explicit Genesis capture candidates via the explicit-action adapter only (no silent promotion).
